W.note: Very small and toggle works with aria-expanded, but the collapsed ETA is truncated, the action buttons wrap awkwardly, and there is no progress or ETA once opened.

X.note: Clean teal-on-dark card with the ETA right in the collapsed state, progress bar, six-step timeline, and tidy buttons, with only a little dead space at the bottom.

Y.note: Good next-step note and timeline with a dismiss and restore tab, but the carrier and tracking number collide and wrap, and the ETA is truncated when collapsed.

Z.note: Polished multi-package toast with progress bar, notify toggle and a select, but it has no explicit ETA when collapsed and a full-width select uses space.
